title: Recording
waveform: Recording waveform. Arrow keys move the playhead, plus and minus zoom, Space plays.
empty: Your voice is recorded while Scribe listens. Play it back, scrub through it, and export it here.
off: Recording is off: Scribe only turns your words into tickets.
discardConfirm: Discard this recording? It isn't saved anywhere yet.

problems.mic-denied: The microphone is blocked, so nothing is being recorded. Allow it for wordsmith, then press the mic again.
problems.mic: The recorder couldn't open the microphone. Scribe still hears you; press the mic again to retry.
problems.limit: This recording is an hour long, the most one can hold. Export or discard it to record more.

tapesSaved: Saved to Tapes, with the transcript. The full-quality original stays on this device.
tapesFailed: Couldn't save to Tapes ({detail}). The recording is kept on this device.
